findings.the verdict: 44 of 44 recorded trios place 34 times, of which 39 also close on C-0057's own verdict grid
findings.what survives every clause at once: 17 of the 44 recorded trios place 34 times, close on C-0057's own verdict grid, carry a base C-0037's TwoLinkBase invariant can represent at the centre the register offers, AND leave the tile flat at C-0063's own convention — the 9, 11 and 12 bp rows. The 6 bp row survives every clause but the flatness, at an array translated 3.91 nm; the 7, 8 and 10 bp rows fail the base
findings.the row pitch the array chooses: a base misalignment FLOOR is a minimum over the axial position on the host duplex, and the array pins that position. At the centre the register offers nearest the station the 10 bp row — C-0062's own recommended design — reads 57.0° against its published 6.0° floor, past the half right angle at which C-0037's TwoLinkBase invariant cannot represent a base at all; the 9 bp row reads 18.0° and is what the array can actually build
findings.the shape of the answer: every one of C-0063's 34 stations is the SAME helical phase of its own host duplex — 1 class, at [24.0] bp from the duplex's own NORTH plane — so the register is one question, not thirty-four, and the placed count is quantised at 0 or 34
findings.what binds: the plan does not: 34 truss blocks cover 0.385 of the footprint and the widest crossbar's demand is 9.49 nm against a 10.88 nm pitch. What decides it is the base REGISTER, which is a coordinate C-0059's and C-0062's floors minimise over and an array pins
findings.the flexure reading: with C-0030's flexure the same array covers 1.94 of the footprint and cannot place at one level at all — C-0041's obstruction at 34 paths, and it is independent of every trio
findings.what this cannot establish: a torsion closure is a NECESSARY condition and never a sufficient one. Nothing here is measured, no sequence is designed, and the motif — a free lever held to a single-layer sheet by one crossover — is this programme's own construct (C-0055, 62 recorded queries)
